title: Soft utilities
description: A mod to make some tasks less boring.
body:
This mod was created with the intention of removing the task of constantly switching to the correct tool and helping with tool repairs and crop management.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

additional items
-wooden Paxel
-Stone Paxel
-Iron Paxel
-Golden Paxel
-Diamond Paxel
-Netherite Paxel
-Automatic-farm
-Repair table

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

How to use:
- For the automatic farm, you will need to place a bucket of water in the lower left slot, and the product you want to grow goes next to it. After a certain number of ticks, 1 of the cultivated item will be generated (only carrots, potatoes, wheat).

-At the repair table, you only need to place the damaged item and it will gradually be repaired.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

I wish you a good game. - Exxesivo_111
